content: Directory enumeration on arduino-esp32 SD: File dir = SD.open("/images"); while (File f = dir.openNextFile()) { f.name(), f.size(), f.isDirectory() }. On arduino-esp32 2.x+ name() returns just the filename (not full path). PERFORMANCE CAVEAT: enumeration is sequential-only and can be slow (~4s/100 files reported); with hundreds of images a per-request full rescan is too slow for a 5s poll. Mitigation: cache the index in RAM (ids are bounded uint16), rebuild only on finalized-image count change / on demand.
